criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Create a new alarm with specified time, date, or label.

categories.name: Manage Alarm
categories.definition: View, modify, delete, or inquire about existing alarms.

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: Create a new reminder with specified content, time, or recipient.

categories.name: Manage Reminder
categories.definition: View, modify, delete, or inquire about existing reminders.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Create a new timer with a specified duration.

categories.name: Manage Timer
categories.definition: View, modify, delete, or inquire about existing timers.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Initiate music, radio, or audio playback.

categories.name: Control Music Playback
categories.definition: Interact with currently playing music or audio (e.g., skip, repeat, identify).

categories.name: Initiate Call
categories.definition: Start a voice or video call to a contact or number.

categories.name: Manage Call
categories.definition: Control an active call (e.g., answer, hang up, hold).

categories.name: Send Message
categories.definition: Send a text or video message to a contact or group.

categories.name: Retrieve Communication History
categories.definition: Inquire about past calls or messages.

categories.name: Get General Information
categories.definition: Ask for facts, definitions, recipes, or how-to instructions.

categories.name: Get Weather Information
categories.definition: Ask for current or future weather conditions.

categories.name: Get News Information
categories.definition: Ask for current news headlines or details on specific topics.

categories.name: Get Contact/Social Information
categories.definition: Inquire about or manage contacts, their attributes, or social connections.

categories.name: Event Management
categories.definition: Inquire about, RSVP to, or manage events and activities.

categories.name: Set Assistant Status
categories.definition: Change the assistant's or user's operational status or mode.
